article_summaries.title: Double Station Cash Weekend. Don't Miss Out!!
article_summaries.summary: A limited-time promotion in which retail Free Realms Station Cash game cards, redeemed within a set window, gave double their value in Station Cash. Starter Cards were excluded, and the article lists participating retailers only as a missing image or link list, so no retailer names appear in the text. The post says it was posted 5 days before capture (captured 2010-04-05), so it likely dates to about 2010-03-31, but the exact date is not stated.

article_summaries.title: Double Station Cash Weekend. Don't Miss Out!!
article_summaries.summary: A limited promotion in which pre-paid Free Realms Station Cash retail game cards (except Starter Cards) redeemed during a weekend window gave double their value in Station Cash, for players with accounts in good standing. The page gives no year; it says it was posted 1 year 4 months before capture (2011-02-08), and the stated redemption dates (Friday September 18 to Sunday September 20) match 2009.
